body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2, issue #1043). The remaining autopilot test suites and helpers (gates-fixture.mjs, review-ctx.mjs, paths.test.mjs, tools.test.mjs) manually invoke mkdtempSync and manage fixture cleanups via manual try/finally or custom cleanup functions, and are allowlisted in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs. With @adlc/core/test-kit (tmp), fixture directories automatically register cleanup via t.after when passed the test context t.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In packages/autopilot/test/helpers/gates-fixture.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update scratch(prefix, t = null) to use tmp(t, prefix).
2. In packages/autopilot/test/helpers/review-ctx.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update scratch(prefix, t = null) to use tmp(t, `${prefix}-`).
3. In packages/autopilot/test/paths.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update test declarations to accept t from test(...).
   - Replace realpathSync(mkdtempSync(...)) with tmp(t, 'ap-paths-').
   - Remove manual try/finally block, unindenting test body.
4. In packages/autopilot/test/tools.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update fixture(t) to accept t and allocate root via tmp(t, 'ap-tools-').
   - Update test declarations to accept t and pass to fixture(t).
   - Remove manual try/finally blocks, unindenting test bodies.
5. In scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs:
   - Remove all 4 packages/autopilot/test/* entries from the ALLOWLIST set (completely eradicates packages/autopilot from allowlist).
6. Verification:
   - node --test packages/autopilot/test/paths.test.mjs packages/autopilot/test/tools.test.mjs exits 0.
   - node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
   - grep -c 'finally' packages/autopilot/test/paths.test.mjs packages/autopilot/test/tools.test.mjs outputs 0 and 0.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 packages/autopilot/test/paths.test.mjs and packages/autopilot/test/tools.test.mjs contain 0 finally blocks.
- AC2 mkdtempSync is not called in gates-fixture.mjs, review-ctx.mjs, paths.test.mjs, or tools.test.mjs.
- AC3 grep -E 'packages/autopilot/test/' scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs returns nothing.
- AC4 node --test packages/autopilot/test/paths.test.mjs packages/autopilot/test/tools.test.mjs exits 0.
- AC5 node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
- AC6 adlc rails-guard exits 0.
title: refactor(autopilot): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit in remaining autopilot tests and test helpers
